description: Curve Finance pools on Ethereum (all but the tiniest, as Curve's 'big' list): pool name, total USD value locked in the pool, and each coin with its USD price and balance, sorted by pool size. Optional name filter. Related tools on this server, for a different need: crypto_curve_gauge_weights when you need Curve Finance gauges on one chain: CRV emission APR range; crypto_balancer_v2_pools when you need Balancer V2 pools by total liquidity: pool name, type. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
